'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Lumut mid-air collision]]
**Two [[Royal Malaysian Navy]] helicopters collide in mid-air during a rehearsal parade in [[Lumut, Perak|Lumut]], [[Malaysia]], killing all ten people on board. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-helicopter-crash-10-dead-navy-training-4285051 (CNA)]
*[[English Channel migrant crossings (2018–present)|English Channel migrant crossings]]

*At least 21 migrants die after their boat capsizes off the coast of [[Djibouti]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/un-migration-agency-16-dead-28-missing-after-boat-capsizes-off-djibouti-coast-2024-04-23/ (Reuters)]
